reviews.author: Rik van Riel
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the naming of the new function, suggesting it may be semantically similar to an existing function.

reviews.author: Yeoreum Yun
reviews.summary: Suggested alternative names for the new function, including gup_skip_unshare_pages() and gup_pages_not_requiring_unshare().
reviews.raw_body:
On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 02:21:18PM -0500, Rik van Riel wrote:
> On Tue, 2026-11-10 at 14:04 +0100, David Hildenbrand (Arm) wrote:
> > On 11/10/26 10:58, Yeoreum Yun wrote:
> > > Hi Rik,
> > > 
> > > > On Mon, 2026-11-09 at 12:32 +0000, Yeoreum Yun wrote:
> > > > > This is preparatory patch to make gup_fast_pte_range()
> > > > > batchable.
> > > > > 
> > > > > Introduce gup_unshared_pages() to count consecutive pages
> > > > > within a
> > > > > folio
> > > > > that do not require unsharing, and use it to implement
> > > > > gup_must_unshare().
> > > > > 
> > > > Could gup_exclusive_pages() be a better name?
> > > 
> > > Yes. This seems much better for me. I'll change it in next-spin.
> > 
> > Not quite the right semantics. For pagecache folios we simply don't
> > need
> > unsharing in MAP_SHARED VMAs. That does not imply that these are
> > exclusive.
> > 
> > So it's all about "number of pages that don't need unsharing".
> > 
> gup_no_unshare_len() ?
> 
> a little awkward sounding, but it describes
> what it's doing?

Hmm, Wouldn't this name be semantically much the same as keeping
the existing gup_unshared_page(), since both essentially convey that
no unsharing is required from GUP's perspective?

Anyway, naming is always NP-hard problem :\


-- 
Sincerely,
Yeoreum Yun

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Provided feedback on the naming of the new function, suggesting a longer name that explains its purpose.

reviews.author: Yeoreum Yun
reviews.summary: Asked for permission to post an updated version of the patch with a new name, and suggested gup_skip_unshare_pages() as an alternative.
reviews.raw_body:

> > Hmm, Wouldn't this name be semantically much the same as keeping
> > the existing gup_unshared_page(), since both essentially convey that
> > no unsharing is required from GUP's perspective?
> 
> The function measures how many pages in
> this current interval do not need to be
> unshared.
> 
> I'm happy with any name, though.
> 
> I would really like to just see this
> code go in, so I can post my two
> GUP series on top, first the batching
> for the GUP-slow path, and then the
> series that allows access_remote_vm()
> and friends to work under the per-VMA
> lock.

@David, If you don't have any strong comments for original name
-- gup_unshared_page(), May I post next version with resolving other
comments so that Rik's series be posted soon?

Otherewise, gup_skip_unshare_pages() works for me.
-- 
Sincerely,
Yeoreum Yun
